authorities for family tracing and verification.

sustainable water-resource management through

the restoration and rejuvenation of ponds, lakes

A permanent house is a basic human

under Section 21 of the Rights of Persons with

Disabilities Act, 2016, accessible, barrier-free

working environment has to be provided to

Government and private sector.

An initiative to provide an identity card to

‘Aran’ Shelter homes for transgender

Transgender persons commute from one
